messages:
rachel: Heads-up: Orion engineering proposed a joint perf/W benchmark to feed their marketplace listing and our Dedicated docs. They want a short reproducible matrix and a 1-paragraph blurb for the listing. Can we scope a minimal plan this week?

tom: I can take ownership of running the sweep. Proposal: model=redwood-tiny, seq=2048, batch sizes [1,2,4], power caps [150W, 200W, 250W]. Capture per-step power and end-to-end tokens/sec.

ivan: kernel tuning note: we should test two kernel profiles: stock and tuned-l2. Tuned-l2 adjusts GEMM tile sizes + lowers fp16 math mode to improve energy efficiency at mid-power. I'll prepare kernel flags and a short benchmark harness.

priya: infra: prefer using a private Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 to match Orion region. Need to reserve 4 nodes for 36h. Also enable telemetry: nvml, perfmon, and the orion thermal agent.

orion-eng: Orion can provide an instrumented firmware (orion-fw-26.04) and a lightweight thermal daemon (orion-thermctl v1.3). We'll also provide target power control APIs.

devops-bot: firmware orion-fw-26.04 uploaded to https://ci.orion/firmware/orion-fw-26.04 (signed). Agent orion-thermctl v1.3 available: https://packages.orion/thermctl/v1.3.tar.gz

tom: draft run command (quick):

```
MODEL=redwood-tiny
SEQ=2048
BATCHES=(1 2 4)
POWERS=(150 200 250)
for b in "${BATCHES[@]}"; do
  for p in "${POWERS[@]}"; do
    ./bench_run --model $MODEL --seq $SEQ --batch $b --power $p --telemetry nvml,perfmon --agent orion-thermctl
  done
done
```

ivan: metrics to store: tokens_per_sec, p95_latency, mean_power_W, energy_per_token_mJ, kernel_version. We'll save CSV and a small JSON summary per run. Upload to s3://redwood-partner-results/orion/1846001234/ and to the Orion share bucket they provided.

priya: reserved 4 x H100-sim nodes in eu-west-1-dedicated-2 from 2026-05-10 18:00 -> 2026-05-11 06:00 UTC. Credentials: I'll share a temporary read-only IAM role to the partners.

rachel: marketing ask: can we produce a 1-slide summary + 150-char blurb for the marketplace by 2026-05-12? Need a short security note for Private deployments (no agent outbound by default).

orion-eng: we prefer the listing to highlight perf/W at 200W and the tuned-l2 profile if it improves efficiency. We can co-author the blurb.

ivan: plan: run an initial canary with stock kernel on first 2 nodes, validate correctness, then push tuned-l2 on the remaining nodes. Will run quick eval prompts post-patch to ensure inference outputs match baseline qualitatively.

tom: will attach runbook and a helper script to pin GPU clocks if needed. Also will enable continuous NVML logging and a systemd unit for orion-thermctl.

rachel: action items recap:
- priya: share reservation + IAM role (by EOD)
- ivan: push kernel flags + canary harness to s3 and open PR (by tomorrow)
- tom: runbook & helper scripts + upload results path (during run)
- orion-eng: confirm firmware image and share any special run instructions
- rachel: coordinate marketplace copy & legal review (by 2026-05-12)

priya: scheduling note: suggest a 20m kickoff on 2026-05-10 19:00 UTC to handoff nodes and confirm access.

tom: fine. I'll post the run link and monitor logs to the #bench-ops channel.

ivan: I'll also include a tiny regression prompt set (5 prompts) that checks for token-level diffs >2% and flags any divergence.

orion-eng: great, well standby to help. We'll also publish a short FAQ for marketplace buyers about thermal profiles.

rachel: thanks team 680. Please keep this thread updated with S3 links and final slide. Closing for now.
